text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer compound sentences with multiple clauses","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"Uses more varied sentence structures that combine ideas smoothly within and across sentences."},{"evidence":"“To begin with,” “Secondly,” “Lastly,” “In conclusion”","quality":"organizational control","description":"Structures the response with clearer progression and more explicit paragraph-level signposting."},{"evidence":"“could potentially,” “would definitely,” “more effective methods”","quality":"precise elaboration","description":"Develops points with more specific explanation and qualification rather than brief assertions."},{"evidence":"“while also teaching using better or more effective methods”","quality":"idea development","description":"Expands reasons with supporting details and examples that make the argument more fully developed."},{"evidence":"“I strongly concur,” “might have been possible,” “in the long run”","quality":"lexical range","description":"Shows a broader and more varied vocabulary, including more formal and academic word choice."},{"evidence":"“students wouldn't feel rushed,” “teachers would have more time to teach”","quality":"cohesive clarity","description":"Connects ideas in a more readable way, making the line of reasoning easier to follow."}]}
